svg.aria-label: Animated expected behaviour of the conveyor motor during the test sequence
svg.title: Expected behaviour of the conveyor motor during the test sequence
svg.text: Teal outline = that contact is TRUE (passes power) at this moment.
Idle: no button pressed, motor OFF
START pressed: MOTOR bit sets, motor ON
START released: seal-in contact holds the motor ON
STOP pressed: STOP_PB opens the rung, motor OFF
STOP released: motor stays OFF until START is pressed
START and STOP together: STOP wins, motor stays OFF
